original language: Ziyarat of Hazrat Abu Talib (AS)
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدَ الْبَطْحَآءِ وَابْنَ رَئِيْسِهَا
translation: Peace be upon you, Oh the leader of Mecca, and the son of its chief​

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ الْكَعْبَةِ بَعْدَ تَاْسِيْسِهَا
translation: Peace be with you, Oh inheritor of the Holy Ka’aba after it had been founded​

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا كَافِلَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
translation: Peace be with you, Oh fosterer of the messenger of God​

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَافِظَ دِيْنِ اللهِ
translation: Peace be with you, Oh protector of the religion of God​

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَمَّ الْمُصْطَفٰى
translation: Peace be with you, Oh uncle of Mustafa​

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا اَبَا الْمُرْتَضٰى
translation: Peace be with you, Oh father of the righteous Imam​

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَالِدَ الْاَئِمَّةِ الْهُدٰى
translation: Peace be on you , Oh the father of the guiding leaders

original language: كَفَاكَ بِمَا اَوْلاَكَ اللهُ شَرَفًا وَّ نَسَبًا
translation: Sufficient for you is the nobility and lineage which Allah has rendered you

original language: وَّ حَسْبُكَ بِمَا اَعْطَاكَ اللهُ عِزًّا وَّ حَسَبًا
translation: and enough for you is the honour and esteem that He has granted you

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَرَفَ الْوُجُوْدِ
translation: Peace be on you, Oh the one noble of existence

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَ لِىَّ الْمَعْبُوْدِ
translation: Peace be on you, Oh the friend of worshipped one

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَارِسَ النَّبِىِّ الْمَوْعُوْدِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the protector of the Promised Prophet

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ رُزِقَ وَلَدٌ هُوَ خَيْرُ مَوْلُوْدٍ
translation: Peace be on you, O the one who was granted a son, who is the best of the new-born ones

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ خُصِّصَ بِالْوَلَدِ الزَّكِىِّ الطَّاهِرِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the one who was designated for a chaste

original language: الْمُطَهَّرِ الْعَلِىٍّ اشْتُقَّ اسْمُهُ مِنَ الْعَلِىِّ
translation: pure, purified and lofty son (Ali) whose name is derived from that of Allah’s (Ali)

original language: هَنِيْئًا لَّكَ ثُمَّ هَنِيْئًا لَّكَ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ هُوَ الْمُرْتَضٰى مِنْ رَسُوْلٍ
translation: Congratulations be to you for your son who is the satisfied one of the Apostles,

original language: وَّ اَخُ الرَّسُوْلِ وَ زَوْجُ الْبَتُوْلِ وَ سَيْفُ اللهِ الْمَسْلُوْلُ
translation: the brother of the messenger, the husband of Batool and the ever drawn sword of Allah.

original language: هَنِيْئًا لَّكَ ثُمَّ هَنِيْئًا لَّكَ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ هُوَ مِنْ مُّحَمَّدٍ الْمُصْطَفٰى
translation: Again congratulations be to you for your son whose position with Mohammad al Mustafa

original language: بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُوْنَ مِنْ مُوْسٰى هَنِيْئًا لَّكَ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ هُوَ شَرِيْكُ النُّبُوَّةِ
translation: is like the one with Haroon had with Musa, Congratulations be to you for your son who is a partner in prophethood

original language: وَ الْمَخْصُوْصُ بِا لْاُخُوَّةِ وَ كَاشِفُ الْغُمَّةِ وَ اِمَامُ الْاُمَّةِ وَ اَبُوْ الْاَئِمَّةِ
translation: The chosen one for brotherhood. The removal of sorrow, the leader of the nation and the father of the Imams.

original language: هَنِيْئًا لَّكَ مِنْ وَّ لَدٍ هُوَ قَسِيْمُ الْجَنَّةِ وَ النَّارِ
translation: Congratulations be to you, for your son who is the distributor of Paradise and Hell,

original language: وَ نِعْمَةُ اللهِ عَلَى الْاَبْرَارِ وَ نَقِمَةُ اللهِ عَلَى الْفُجَّارِ
translation: the Bounty of Allah upon the righteous and His Wrath upon the debauchers

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
translation: Peace be on you and on him and on them all and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings.
